hero.subtitle: I'm Leon. An independent product engineer focused on multi-agent systems and the engineering of AI tools. In 3 years, I went from marketer to AI product engineer — and built three products that walk the full 0-to-1 path of the AI era.
hero.status: Currently exploring AI PM / FDE roles in Shenzhen

about.headline: From Hong Kong to Shenzhen — <accent>three products</accent> that walk the full AI product loop.
about.body_1: I graduated from Edinburgh with a linguistics degree in 2022, then fell into cross-border social media. Along the way, I realized something: AI has dropped the floor on making a product to ground level. Getting seen — and getting finished — is the new bottleneck.</
about.body_2: So I started building. First WDA — to cure "how do I use AI" anxiety with a 7-day MVP plan. Then OPC — multi-agents that actually run that plan into real code, real deploy. Finally MediaPilot — to make sure the product gets seen.
about.body_3: After the trilogy, the other three projects are the ones I built because I was curious. Lumora's product constitution. JobHunter's RAG loop. Poker GTO's engineering discipline. They aren't commercialized, but they prove I bring engineering rigor to whatever I touch.
